gaps.lead: The company has a good reputation in the local area.
gaps.sentence: The company ___ of in the local area.
gaps.explanation: 'People speak highly of it' becomes the passive 'it is highly spoken of'.

gaps.lead: The suitcase was so heavy that I couldn't lift it.
gaps.sentence: It was ___ that I couldn't lift it.
gaps.explanation: so + adjective + that → such (+a) + adjective + noun + that.

gaps.lead: 'Why don't we hold the wedding outdoors?' said Ana.
gaps.explanation: suggest + that-clause, or suggest + -ing: suggested they hold / suggested holding.

gaps.lead: 'I broke the window,' the boy said.
gaps.sentence: When caught, the boy ___ the window.
gaps.explanation: admit + -ing, or admit having + past participle for the earlier action.

gaps.lead: Assembling the wardrobe took me two hours.
gaps.explanation: it took me X to do = I spent X doing.

gaps.answer: to put up with any rudeness
gaps.lead: Delia said that she would no longer tolerate her colleagues being rude.
gaps.sentence: 'I am not willing ___ from my colleagues any longer,' said Delia.
gaps.explanation: 'Not willing to put up with rudeness' means will no longer tolerate it.
